journeys.title: Admin businesses — grid, list and table on the shared collection shell
preconditions: An admin user (promoted by the fixture in the dev DB).
notCovered: Edit / delete business — covered by the admin CRUD endpoints.

journeys.title: Admin users — table, key-based selection and list view
preconditions: An admin user (the fixture promotes itself in the dev DB).
notCovered: Ban / unban / delete / impersonate — destructive, needs a dedicated fixture user.
Create user — covered by the server validation tests.

journeys.title: Agent landings — hub, MCP steps, localized page
preconditions: None — the pages are public markdown in the content layer.
notCovered: A live MCP connection — needs an OAuth app and a real client.

journeys.title: Auto-reply — create a campaign, watch a published post, then edit it
preconditions: An active business owned by the fixture user.
A connected Instagram account — fixtures insert one row directly into the dev DB.
One post published through MagicSync on that account — the picker lists only those.
notCovered: AI-generated drafts — needs a live AI provider key and takes ~20s per call.
A real DM delivery — needs Meta App Review with advanced access.
Stats and click counts — no comment traffic exists in the fixture.

journeys.title: Business directory — grid, list, table and search on the shared collection shell
preconditions: A signed-in user with at least one active business (the fixture creates one).
notCovered: Create / edit / delete — covered by the business-create journey.
The onboarding wizard — needs a user with zero businesses.

journeys.title: Content board — create, edit and delete a card by hand
preconditions: An active business owned by the fixture user.
A published Brand Playbook — without it, update/delete return 500 BRAND_CONTEXT_REQUIRED.
notCovered: Find ideas (scan) — needs AI provider keys.
Move to Writing (write now) — needs AI provider keys.
Drag/drop refuse — drag-and-drop is flaky under Playwright and already covered by the component spec.

journeys.title: Dashboard — 30-day trend chart in the MagicSync palette
preconditions: An active business with 30 days of account metrics (fixture-written).
notCovered: Collecting fresh platform stats — needs live platform tokens.

journeys.title: Integrations directory — grid, list and table for providers
preconditions: A signed-in user with an active business.
No social connection required — the empty state is part of the evidence.
notCovered: A real OAuth consent flow — needs live provider credentials.

journeys.title: Media — storage summary, masonry grid and carousel preview
preconditions: An active business with at least six image assets (fixture-written).
notCovered: Uploading a file — needs a real file picker and storage.
Delete/optimize flows — destructive and covered by the API tests.

journeys.title: Posts — grid, list, table, feed and board over one published post
preconditions: A signed-in user with an active business.
One post already published on an Instagram account (fixture-written, with a live URL).
notCovered: Creating/scheduling a post — the composer is covered by the create-post journey.
Deleting from the table — destructive and already covered by the table component.
